name: CarMax Richmond Half Marathon
typicalWeather: Five-year average of about 6 °C at the start and 16 °C in the afternoon (42 °F and 60 °F), per HalfRuns
summary: The CarMax Richmond Half Marathon is part of the Richmond Marathon weekend, known as America's Friendliest Marathon. It starts at 8th and Broad Street in downtown Richmond and finishes with a downhill run to 5th and Byrd Streets. The route passes street art, river views, historic buildings and parks.
courseHighlights: Start at 8th and Broad Street, downtown Richmond
Street art, river views and historic architecture
Party zones, bands and spirit groups along the route
Junk food stop at mile 9 and pickle juice at mile 10
Downhill finish at 5th and Byrd Streets, then Brown's Island

paceStrategy.summary: HalfRuns rates the course ultra-flat, and the official site stresses a downhill finish. Run an even pace and use the last downhill to finish strong. Check the current map, as the course is subject to change.

segments.advice: Start at goal pace or slightly slower while the field spreads.
Hold an even pace and use the water stops.

segments.terrain: Return downtown with a downhill finish
segments.advice: Build the pace over the final downhill to 5th and Byrd Streets.

fuelingNotes: The race site lists water stops at the start and about miles 2, 4, 6, 7 and 9–12, with Tailwind drink at every stop. GU gel and Noogs chews are at mile 7, a junk food stop is at mile 9 and pickle juice is at mile 10.
tips: Know that the start is at 8th and Broad Street, one block from the 8K start
Use the mile 7 gel station if you use GU or chews
Dress for a cool November start; HalfRuns shows an average low of 42 °F
Expect crowd support and party zones along the route, and plan to enjoy it

faq.question: Is the Richmond Half Marathon course flat?
faq.answer: HalfRuns rates it ultra-flat, and the official course page highlights a downhill finish at 5th and Byrd Streets. We found no official climb figure.

faq.question: Where does the Richmond Half Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at 8th and Broad Street and finishes at 5th and Byrd Streets, near Brown's Island.

faq.question: When is the Richmond Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Saturday in mid-November, at 7:15 a.m.
